🌄 Nature and viewpoints

3🌄 Rumah Pohon Tree House

A treehouse on a cliff overlooking the rocky islets and coastline off Atuh Beach.

For sunrise views, arrive early; There is a short steep descent from the parking lot to the houses.

Pejukutan, Nusa Penida, Klungkung, Bali 80771

Map · Instagram

4🌄 Paluang Cliff

Lookout at Kelingking with a side view of the cape and a wooden boat for photos over the cliff.

Leave for 30–60 minutes; The panorama opens without going down to the beach; do not approach the edge of the cliff.

Bunga Mekar, Nusa Penida, Klungkung, Bali 80771

Map · Instagram

5🌄 Broken Beach

A round bay on Nusa Penida with a natural stone arch connecting it to the ocean.

Bunga Mekar, Nusa Penida, Klungkung, Bali

Ubud

☕ Coffee and breakfast

1☕ Yellow Flower Café

Family cafe in a garden on a hill in Sayan; predominantly plant-based menu.

Rp 75,000–200,000 per person · Google Maps

Try Nasi Campur Campuhan or Cold Brew Cashew Coffee; To get to the cafe you need to walk along the steps of Penestanan.

Jl. Raya Campuhan, Sayan, Ubud, Bali 80571

Map · Instagram

2☕ Clear Café Ubud

Cafe with vegetarian, vegan and raw food dishes; eat seafood.

Rp 75,000–200,000 per person · Google Maps

Choose Dragon Bowl with tofu or tempeh or Golden Temple Curry; Seafood options are listed separately.

Jl. Hanoman No.8, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali 80571

Map · Instagram

3☕ Moksa Ubud

Plant-based restaurant with a permaculture garden in Sayan.

Rp 75,000–225,000 per person · Google Maps

Try Tempeh Ribs or Asam Laksa Noodle from the chef's recommendations; last order at 20:30.

Ubud II Kutuh, Jl. Puskesmas, Sayan, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali 80571
